description: Port state control detentions published by the Tokyo MOU (Asia-Pacific) for a month: IMO number, ship name, flag, build date, tonnage, type, class society, recognised organisations, company, place and dates of detention and release, and every detainable deficiency (code, area, item, RO responsibility). Filter by flag (2-letter code), IMO number or port. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

flag.description: Optional flag state as a 2-letter code, e.g. PA (Panama), LR, MH, TG

port.description: Optional words of the detention place, e.g. Shanghai, Singapore

year.description: Year 2000 to now (default: last month's year)
